about: Turn signs for the photographed pegs (photo-rigs.json points), read by ModelLibrary.photoCard into StageCard.turns. +1: clockwise tightens, as the 3D rigs encode it (tools/models: tighten = -side): a key or peg head on the bass side of the head (the left, seen from the front with the head up) is +1, one on the treble side -1, whatever side of centre its post sits. Each entry says what the photograph shows. Photos left out show no turn arrow rather than a guessed one.
skipped: 29_folk_world_strings_renaissance_lute (the bent-back pegbox's two peg rows can't be told apart in this perspective)
39/40 koto and gayageum (movable bridges), the winds (slides), 67 timpani (pedal), 68 kalimba (tines)
